fullContentHtml:
UP Police SI PET Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has released the PET Exam Date for the UP Police Sub-Inspector (SI) Recruitment 2026 after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for a total of 4,543 posts. Applications for the UP Police SI Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 12 August 2025 to 11 September 2025. The PET examination is going to be conducted on 29, 30 June 2026 & 01 July 2026. Candidates who appeared in the exam can now check their UP Police SI PET Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 August 2025
  • Last Date : 11 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 September 2025
  • Correction Date : 12 to 15 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 14-15 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 06 March 2026
  • Admit Card : 11 March 2026
  • Answer Key Available : March 2026
  • Result : 07 May 2026
  • DV & PST Date : 15 – 16 June 2026
  • DV & PST Admit Card : 05 June 2026
  • Re Print Form : 12 June 2026
  • PET Exam Date : 29-30 June 2026 & 01 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
